tool: Built-in image generation; original Moonlight character series

prompts.werewolf: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original portrait illustration for a premium mobile Werewolf party game character card, Moonlight. Create a single full-bleed 2:3 portrait, no text, no lettering, no borders, no logos. Cohesive collectible storybook art direction: sophisticated hand-painted gouache and delicate etched silver linework, slightly stylized expressive forms, textured velvet shadows, midnight navy #101426, muted lavender #b7a0df, moon-silver highlights, tiny restrained warm accent. Not photorealistic, not anime, not 3D. Moonlit medieval woodland village atmosphere, poetic and mysterious rather than horror. Waist-up central character; face in upper middle, complete head comfortably inside frame, clean strong silhouette legible at 240px wide, beautifully detailed clothes with simple larger shapes. The pale moon behind the head forms a circular halo. Edges fade naturally to midnight blue. The four-role series should look painted by the same original illustrator. No graphic violence, no modern items, no text or tarot numbering. Subject: a majestic silver-furred anthropomorphic WEREWOLF with unmistakable wolf head, pointed ears, alert amber eyes, dark indigo cloak fastened with a crescent silver clasp, quiet cunning rather than snarling. One clawed hand partly visible. An eclipsed pale lavender moon and tall dark pine trees behind. Silvery fur and violet shadows; one restrained amber eye accent. High contrast face, noble and dangerous.
